name: agy-supervised-development
description: Pluginized Codex-supervised development workflow with AGY as the primary writer, Git as delivery evidence, and optional browser-runtime verification.

interface.shortDescription: Codex shapes and proves; AGY builds; Git and runtime evidence tell the truth.
interface.longDescription: A workflow-first supervised development plugin. Codex owns shaping, specification, slicing, review, independent verification and final acceptance; AGY is the primary implementation writer; Chrome DevTools MCP can be negotiated as an optional Codex-owned browser runtime verification adapter; tty7 remains an interactive fallback.
capabilities: Delegate bounded execution units to AGY
Run Three-Axis Review and independent verification
Use Chrome DevTools MCP for applicable runtime diagnosis and verification
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AGY Supervised Development for this task. Preserve the workflow kernel and repository evidence boundaries. For browser-runtime work, negotiate Chrome DevTools MCP before Spec freeze when no effective preference exists.
